headline: Mutual funds poured ₹7,011 cr crore into ITC in October

modes.bear: Heavy buying may already price in expectations, limiting upside and could lead to short‑term profit‑taking pressure.
modes.bull: Large fund inflow into ITC signals confidence and could push its share price higher in the near term.
modes.simple: Mutual funds bought a huge amount of ITC shares in October, which may boost the stock’s price and affect investors holding it.

summary: Mutual funds bought ITC shares worth ₹7,011 crore in October 2026, the largest large‑cap purchase this month. They also added sizable stakes in BSE, Motherson Sumi Systems, Zetwerk, Max Healthcare and JSW Dulux across market caps. The buying reflects fund managers' confidence and could lift the stocks' prices. Retail investors holding or eyeing these shares may benefit from price appreciation and higher liquidity.
why_it_matters: Fund buying may lift stock prices

headline: JSW Dulux reports 9.2% drop in Q2 net profit to Rs 89 crore
hook: Profit dips despite higher revenue at JSW Dulux
summary: JSW Dulux, formerly Akzo Nobel India Ltd, reported a 9.2% decline in net profit to ₹89 crore for the July-September quarter, compared to ₹97.8 crore in the same period last year. Total revenue for the quarter rose to ₹962 crore according to a regulatory filing. The paints maker faces margin compression as higher sales failed to translate into bottom-line growth. Retail investors holding the stock should review upcoming margin trends in the competitive paints sector.
whats_next: December quarter earnings results in January 2025
why_it_matters: Earnings growth slows for the paints maker.
